config.window.title: Chat Proximity Config
config.general.verticalIncrease.tooltip: Enabling this setting increases the importance of vertical distance when calculating proximity. Vertical distances will weigh more heavily when determining chat range, which can be useful in multi-floor or elevated areas.
config.general.insideReducer: Reduce the chat range while inside a housing
config.general.insideReducer.tooltip: When enabled, this option reduces the effective chat range while inside a house or apartment, allowing for more immersive communication by adjusting distance calculations.
config.general.recolorTargeting.tooltip: When enabled, messages sent by a player you are targeting will have a specific color.
config.general.recolorTargeted: Recolor message when sender targets you
config.general.recolorTargeted.tooltip: When enabled, messages from a player targeting you will have a specific color.
config.general.recolorFocusTarget: Recolor message when sender is your focus target
config.general.recolorFocusTarget.toolti: When enabled, messages from a player you have in focus target will have a specific color.
config.general.editThreshold.tooltip: Enabling this option adds a 'Threshold' column to the chat configuration table. This column allows you to set a maximum distance for each channel, beyond which messages will be entirely suppressed and not displayed. Warning: Messages from a distance greater than the specified threshold will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered. Use with caution.
config.general.anonymiseLogs.tooltip: When this option is enabled, player names will be anonymized in Dalamud's debug logs. This is useful for protecting privacy in logs created for plugin debugging or troubleshooting.
threshold.tooltip: Right-click to manually enter a precise value.
threshold.popup.title: Edit Threshold
